scope: blind exact-row input, output and pair verification

reviews.critique: The input is a coherent, plausible revision request with recoverable intent and no authoring leakage or artificial padding. The output provides clear, professional prose while remaining a request rather than creating the form. Paragraph-by-paragraph, it preserves the product types, pickup hours, cake sizes, exact decoration quotations, allergy safeguards, deposit amounts and thresholds, change-approval conditions, ordering cutoffs, paper and digital requirements, and follow-up instructions. It also retains the distinctions between preferred and confirmed pickup times, requested and accepted changes, and customer confirmation versus acceptance of late orders. No material omission, added fact, or change in certainty is evident.

The input is plausible natural dictation with clear intent and no artificial padding or authoring instructions. The output appropriately capitalizes names and sentences, removes the accidental repetition in “the the first time” and the hesitation “um,” and preserves the meaningful “Well.” All substantive details remain intact, including six versus the calendar’s unchanged five thirty, the conditional restaurant plan and calling-ahead note, the original two-carton entry versus the one-carton need, and Grandma’s unanswered dessert question. No lexical paraphrasing or material omissions occur.

The input is a coherent, detailed draft with recoverable intent and no leaked authoring instructions or artificial padding. The output makes natural, restrained prose edits appropriate to /polish, such as changing “put in place” to “installed.” Across all paragraphs, it preserves names, dates, quantities, quotations, unresolved decisions, and uncertainty. In particular, the frame inspection remains conditional on the next latch adjustment failing, and the plastic sleeve remains conditional on finding a spare. No material omissions, unsupported additions, or changes in certainty are evident.

The input is coherent, natural operational prose with no contradictory requirements, artificial padding, or leaked authoring instructions. The output is byte-identical, as required by the identity flag, and retains the clear professional language and formatting. All paragraphs, bay-specific instructions, shift times, the below-10°C condition, quoted observations, backup-worker conditions, and recordkeeping requirements are preserved without omissions or changes in certainty.

The input is a coherent, self-contained request with recoverable intent and no contradictory requirements or artificial padding. The output appropriately reorganizes it into an engineering prompt without performing the task. It preserves the supplied function, default and configurable widths, ordered and unmodified row handling, validation boundary, shared-storage distinction, exact quotations, 119-row sample and slice boundaries, empty and partial cases, and required test coverage. Mara’s and Noah’s remarks remain unverified discussion points rather than system guarantees. The four-part deliverable structure, prohibition on writing importer code or claiming completed changes, and closing requirement that reports reflect batches actually processed are retained. No material defect found.

The input is plausible dictation with clear intent and an explicit passenger correction. The output appropriately applies “my brother no sorry my sister” as “my sister” and otherwise limits changes to capitalization and punctuation, including the spelled name N-I-N-A. All train times, passenger names, booking reference, fare-approval requirements, seating conditions, destination restriction, and unchanged return journey are preserved. No material defects found.

The input is a coherent studio-access procedure with no apparent contradictions, artificial noise, or leaked authoring instructions. The output is natural and preserves the input byte-for-byte, as required for this identity case. All paragraphs, numbered steps, quotations, names, dates, access restrictions, privacy provisions, and verification conditions remain unchanged; no unauthorized /transcribe paraphrasing occurs.

The input is a coherent, recoverable drafting request with substantive operational notes and no artificial padding or contradictory instructions. The output appropriately organizes a self-contained prompt rather than writing the brief or implementing the utility. It preserves the host rollout, paths, estimates, filenames, operator quotations, retention periods, audit protection, archive-unavailability condition, greater-than-2-GB acknowledgement threshold, default dry run, exact CSV header, reporting requirements, and unresolved policy questions. It also retains the evidence-before-recommendations ordering, numbered-checklist rule limited to recommendations, and closing requirement to identify decisions needed before unattended deletion without declaring readiness. Language and formatting are natural and appropriate; no material defect found.

The input is a coherent, natural draft with recoverable intent and no apparent padding or leaked instructions. The output provides friendly, readable polish while retaining all paragraphs and the numbered list. It preserves the scheduling conditions, names, quantities, quoted calendar entries, and uncertainty—including Leo's before-noon text requirement, the conditional Thursday-to-Friday move, seating for six, and the tentative Sunday reminder. Changes such as “keep in line” to “keep in sync” improve phrasing without materially changing meaning. No material omissions or unsupported additions found.

The input is a plausible, coherent dictation with recoverable intent and a clear correction about which computer to use. The output appropriately removes “uh” and adjusts capitalization while preserving meaningful “Well,” the correction to use the speaker’s desktop, the literal transfer.allow_resume, and the North Desk profile name. All quantities, timing, test-only scope, and restrictions on uploading, restarting, and creating profiles remain intact. No material transcription or formatting defect.

The input is plausible dictation with recoverable intent and no contradictions or authoring instructions. The output appropriately removes the repeated “the” and hesitation “um,” adds punctuation and capitalization, and hyphenates “sixty-two” without lexical paraphrasing. All names, dates, measurements, observations, document-handling requests, uncertainty about the blue mark’s cause, conditional follow-up, and the explicit instruction not to change the dye record are preserved.

The input is a coherent, recoverable configuration request with a natural explicit correction. The output appropriately removes the superseded folder order and hesitation, retaining Downloads before the library folder. It preserves reader.prefer_local, both book counts and their meaning, the no-moving-files constraint, profile scope, font size and page-position requirements, untested status, and the request about additional settings. Capitalization and Wi-Fi spelling are appropriate transcription cleanup; there is no material paraphrasing or omission.
